scope: 本机虚构小样本，仅这些查询，不代表生产规模计划

plans.name: charge-date
plans.sql: SELECT id,amount FROM charge_orders WHERE paid_at>=? AND paid_at<?

plan.detail: SEARCH charge_orders USING INDEX ix_charge_paid_at (paid_at>? AND paid_at<?)

plans.name: audit-date
plans.sql: SELECT id,user_id,action FROM audit_logs WHERE created_at>=? AND created_at<? ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 20

plan.detail: SEARCH audit_logs USING INDEX ix_audit_time_id (created_at>? AND created_at<?)

plans.name: stock-batch
plans.sql: SELECT id,drug_id,quantity,expiry_date FROM drug_stocks WHERE drug_id IN (?,?) ORDER BY expiry_date,id

plan.detail: USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
